method: Independent standard-library arithmetic and artifact checks; no production, analyzer or reviewer imports.
preregistered_scope: Final candidate; single replay of all 48 known original cases with unchanged prompt bytes/order/rubrics; not fresh evidence.

source_verification.working_drift_interpretation: Working drift is permitted only when another explicit source root, normally the historical archive, is verified. It never changes the cohort's archived candidate.

actual_calls.timing_interpretation: Backend load is part of backend total; call wall is part of case wall. No causal overhead estimate is inferred.

resources.residency_scope: Snapshots show startup/final empty. Existing backend checks enforce at most one resident model; raw tegrastats has no model-residency field.

memory.error_interpretation: Recorded retrieval errors are candidate outcomes, not empty-result successes or artifact-integrity failures.

prompt_boundaries.scope: Checks hidden rubric-field keys, case IDs, and unique complete rubric sentences >=40 characters/6 words absent from authorized input. Generic mode words are intentionally excluded; this literal check is not proof against semantic leakage.

interpretation: This single cohort is never merged with another attempt. Known development/replay cases do not become fresh by receiving new model outputs.
